recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: arguments about minds, machines, and what simulation can never quite touch
thirty-year-old server handshakes still trusted behind modern glass
a spring evening in the city with glass-clear air and slow gold light
quiet rules about how a price tag may look at you in the aisle
headlines from far capitals folding into background static

composer-2-fast.concept: Catch falling waveform shards that arrive in quantized stutter-house bursts; holding freezes them so you can merge pairs into a solid beam before the beat window closes.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: tap to snatch, hold to freeze shard, release to drop into merge slot
composer-2-fast.session_hook: each clean merge stacks a new layer of pulse in the mix
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and windows shrink; occasional fake drops swap colors
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon oscilloscope dance floor, sub-bass glow

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw one unbroken line through a grid of sleeping lanterns; only your path order wakes them, and a broken stroke puts the block back to sleep.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag finger, lift to commit segment
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: the whole block lighting at once feels like turning on a neighborhood
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: lanterns begin dimming if you hesitate; dead-ends multiply
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: ink-wash alley at blue hour, warm paper lanterns

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Sort drifting mood-cards into three foggy bays before labels dissolve — Swedish pop neon, dream-pop haze, and rap pulse swap buckets each wave.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: swipe card left, up, or right into a lane
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: clearing a wave peels back static to reveal a clean verse of color
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: genres invert mid-round; duplicate cards masquerade as genres

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick glass prisms across a rooftop to bend clear-sky beams onto origami sun-flowers before clouds scrape the light away.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick prism, small drag to nudge after bounce
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each bloom rings a tiny bell and leaves a lingering flare
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind tilts trajectories; faster cloud bands and roaming shade
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: SF spring rooftop, paper-glass flora, low haze
